metric_definitions.base_item_mean_cosine: Off-diagonal mean cosine of at most 2048 base-table rows; directional alignment, not whole-model collapse.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin: Complete positive-minus-negative scores on at most two batches of 32 public training users; small means margin below 1; not validation accuracy.
metric_definitions.attention_entropy: Mean candidate-conditioned attention entropy in natural units on sampled positive and negative targets.
metric_definitions.effective_attended_history_count: Mean exp(entropy), using the same target-conditioned weights.
metric_definitions.attention_status: Measured, no_valid_positions, or unavailable for baseline/recency-only models.
metric_definitions.residual_scores: Complete score minus base dot product on the same sampled targets; includes fixed alpha.
metric_definitions.residual_to_base_rms_ratio: Residual RMS divided by base-score RMS, with denominator floor 1e-6.
metric_definitions.raw_branch_table_norms: Raw row L2 norm summaries for the first at most 2048 nonpadding rows of each branch table.
metric_definitions.last_retained_branch_gradient_norms: L2 norms of retained gradients from the last training backward pass; null if unavailable; no diagnostic backward pass.
